qualification: Timestamp is the parent's captured evidence time used as the latest supplied UTC anchor, not a claim that coordinator validation occurred at that instant.
checks: every input exists as a regular non-symlink leaf
every input SHA-256 and byte size matched
original prompt and original manifest matched their historical identities
scope: Read-only packet/input validation only; no source, git, model, check, PG, network, push, or remote action.
caveat: Parent must independently repeat all guards and verify current repository/remote/worker state immediately before launch.
